name: nexus-workbench
description: Access to an Insai Workbench workspace from Codex: reads by default, and with the scopes you choose, marks proposed for review, review tasks and analyses. Plus local tools for EEG files. Early access. For research use only.

interface.longDescription: Access to an Insai Workbench workspace: reads by default, and with the scopes you choose at sign-in, marks proposed as a review layer, review tasks and analyses. Plus local tools for EEG files. Early access. For research use only. Not for clinical decision-making.
